axis: B — additive (interaction-free) member: EBM/GAM stand-in via boosted stumps
hypothesis: An additive-only model (Friedman gradient-boosted stumps: each tree a single split on one feature, so the ensemble is a per-feature step-function sum with no interactions) contributes errors sufficiently uncorrelated with the existing auxiliary arm to improve the mean-logit aggregate, and/or provides diversity evidence for the unresolved champion-B direction.
prior_evidence: S6E7 lesson: additive structures add nothing once interactions are modeled (cross_competition/cross_season_lessons.md).
Champion B test-side diversity collapses: all measured members >= 0.997 correlated with champion.
aux10 members are full-interaction LGBM/XGB/Cat on the same full view; an additive constraint is the structurally different axis still available inside installed certified machinery.

interpretML/pyGAM are NOT installed; the honest cheap instantiation of the EBM/GAM hypothesis is boosted stumps (num_leaves=2, max_depth=1) trained via the certified _fit_lgbm_es path with the inner ES protocol.

model_spec.family: lightgbm via scripts/run_views.py _fit_lgbm_es (ES on inner es rows, early_stopping 300)

wave1_scope.aggregation_predeclared: aux11_logits = (10 * aux_logits_ctrl + logit(p_stump)) / 11 — plain append to the mean-logit convention, no weights, no member removal
wave1_scope.control: certified aux10 chain via classical() (hash-verified) and the champion identity compose(route2_f0, aux_ctrl) == certified portfolio.npy, asserted exact
wave1_scope.primary_metric: portfolio fold-0 delta vs champion v7 with exact pair-credit identity
wave1_scope.secondary: stump standalone AUC; Pearson/Spearman correlation with champion portfolio, aux10, and route2 on fold 0 (diversity evidence for champion-B research only)

advance_bar_predeclared: Extend to primary folds 1-4 ONLY IF the fold-0 PORTFOLIO delta >= +3.0e-5 (same bar as H18-C). Below that, close H18-B at wave 1.
diversity_clause: A low correlation (<= 0.99) with the champion is recorded as champion-B evidence but does NOT extend the wave and does NOT promote anything: champion B requires a structurally different model under a different protocol and full gate evidence. No hedge is constructed from this probe.
stop_conditions: Any fidelity assertion fails (feature hash, library versions, EV gap > 1e-10): status INVALID, no modelling verdict, stop.
Fold-0 portfolio delta < +3.0e-5: close as NEGATIVE/INSUFFICIENT at wave 1.
Cumulative CPU wall > 1h for H18-B: stop and record partial state.
No public-LB consultation at any point.
champion_invariance: Wave 1 touches no champion artifact; v7 stays byte-identical regardless of outcome.
